reading_rule: Every value is {value, source}. source is one of: measured (a command ran here), declared (a file on this machine asserts it, unchecked), unknown (nothing established it; unknown_because says what would). A null value is never a compatible default.

is_the_target_machine.unknown_because: not established. This host reports an "RTX 5060 Laptop GPU"; the plan targets an "RTX 5060". Only the hardware owner can confirm whether they are the same deployment target.

minimum_build_required_by_registry.unknown_because: no registry row on this machine carries a minLlamaBuild field. src-tauri/src/registry/mod.rs documents b10828 for Spark's spark2_5 architecture, but with the field absent the launch gate cannot fire.

containers.unblock_command: Start Docker Desktop (or `podman machine start`), then re-run this script.

renderers.note: Word, PowerPoint and Excel files are written by Rust directly as OOXML (src-tauri/Cargo.toml: `zip`), so no renderer is needed to PRODUCE them. A renderer is needed to RASTERISE a page or slide for visual review (plan §5.9) and to reopen a workbook with a real recalculation engine (plan §5.6).

max_image_tokens_wired.measured_by: ocr_profile.rs module documentation: server_args builds --image-max-tokens and nothing but its own unit test calls it; serving::plan_launch does not emit it and the request body has no field for it.

decode_cap_wired.measured_by: ocr_profile.rs: max_decode_tokens is sent per request as max_tokens

repetition_control.value: DRY settings approximating Baidu's no_repeat_ngram_size=35 over a 128-token window. An approximation, not a reproduction; ocr_profile.rs says so and says it must be measured.
